Salom, do'stim!.intro_en: Hello, friends! I am Kabutar the bird. I missed you! Let's say hello and tell our names.
tests_en: Your friend asks, "What's your name?" What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's talk to Kabutar the bird. Kabutar: Hello! What's your name? Child: Hello! My name is… (say your name). Kabutar: Goodbye! Child: Goodbye!

Sanaymiz: bir–to'rt.intro_en: Hello! Let's count with Kabutar. One, two, three, four! Count with me!

extras_en.matn_en: I count, you clap! One — one clap. Two — two claps. Three — three claps. Four — four claps! Now you count!

Sanaymiz: besh–yetti.intro_en: Hi, friends! We know one to four. Now let's count five, six, seven!
tests_en: How many fingers are on one hand?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's sing: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Sing it slow, then fast! Show one finger for every number.

Sanaymiz: sakkiz–o'n.intro_en: Hello again! Let's count to ten. Eight, nine, ten! How many can you count?
tests_en: How many apples?
How many fingers are on two hands?

extras_en.matn_en: The rocket is ready! Let's count down: ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one! Now jump up high — we fly!

Bu mening onam.intro_en: Hello, friends! I love my family. Look! This is my mum. Let's meet your family too!

This is my sister..sentence: This is my sister. Her name is Laylo.

This is my brother..sentence: This is my brother. He is big.

tests_en: Show your dad. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Draw your family or show a photo. Point and say: This is my mum. This is my dad. This is my brother. Very nice!

Buvim va bobom.intro_en: Hi! Today we visit grandma and grandpa. They love us very much!

grandpa.sentence: My grandpa has a big garden.

extras_en.matn_en: Show your fingers and sing: Daddy finger, mummy finger, brother finger, sister finger, baby finger — family! At the end, hug all your fingers!

Qalaysan, do'stim?.intro_en: Good morning, friends! How are you? I'm fine, thank you! Let's talk with our friends.

I'm fine, thank you..sentence: I'm fine, thank you. And you?

tests_en: Your friend asks, "How are you?" What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Good morning! How are you? Child: I'm fine, thank you! Now change: you ask, Kabutar answers!

Katta va kichik.intro_en: Hello! Look at the elephant. It is big! Look at the mouse. It is small!
tests_en: Look at the elephant. Is it big or small?
It is your birthday. You get a present. How do you feel?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's say it: My dad is big. My baby brother is small. My mum is happy. Now talk about your family!

Futbolka va shim.intro_en: Hello, friends! Let's get dressed. Look at my clothes! What do you wear today?

dress.sentence: My sister has a pink dress.

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar is putting clothes out to dry. Point to the clothes I say: T-shirt! Dress! Trousers! Shorts! Well done!

Poyabzal va paypoq.intro_en: Hi! We go outside. First socks, then shoes! Put on your shoes, please.
tests_en: What do you put on your feet first?

extras_en.matn_en: Listen and act: Put on your socks! Put on your shoes! Put on your boots! Who is fast?

Issiq kiyimlar.intro_en: Brr! It is cold outside. Let's put on warm clothes: a hat, a coat and gloves!

scarf.sentence: My scarf is long and green.

gloves.sentence: My gloves are on my hands.

tests_en: Your hands are cold. What do you put on?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's dress Kabutar! I say, you show: hat — on your head. Scarf — on your neck. Gloves — on your hands. Coat — on you!

Mening kiyimim.intro_en: Hello, friends! Look at me! My T-shirt is red. What colour are your clothes?

My shoes are blue..sentence: My shoes are blue and small.

Put on your hat!.sentence: It's cold. Put on your hat!

tests_en: "My shoes are blue." Which picture is it?

extras_en.matn_en: Look at your clothes! Say: My T-shirt is red. Or blue, green, yellow. Now talk about your friend's clothes!

Nonushta.intro_en: Good morning! It is time for breakfast. Let's eat bread, eggs and cheese. Yummy!

milk.sentence: I drink milk in the morning.

extras_en.matn_en: Let's give the dolls breakfast! Put it on the table and say: bread, milk, egg, cheese. Yummy!

Ichimliklar.intro_en: Hi, friends! I'm thirsty. Let's drink something. Water, juice or tea?
tests_en: What does grandma drink in the morning?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Water or juice? Child: Juice, please! Kabutar: Here you are. Child: Thank you! Now you ask!

Tushlik.intro_en: Hello! It's lunch time. I'm hungry! Let's eat soup and rice.
tests_en: What does "I'm hungry" mean?

extras_en.matn_en: You are the cook! Put rice and chicken in the pot. Mix, mix! Kabutar: I'm hungry! Cook: Here is soup!

Shirinliklar.intro_en: Hello, friends! I love sweet things. Cake, ice cream, sweets. Yummy!

ice cream.sentence: I like ice cream in summer.

tests_en: We put candles on it on a birthday. What is it?

extras_en.matn_en: Put candles on the cake and count: one, two, three, four, five! Blow! Now eat the cake — Yummy!

Mening uyim.intro_en: Hello! Welcome to my house! Look, here is the door. Come in, please!

house.action_en: Draw a house in the air!

extras_en.matn_en: Take paper and a pencil! Draw a house, a door, two windows and a garden. Then point and say each word!

Uydagi xonalar.intro_en: Hi, friends! My house has many rooms. Let's walk and look at every room!

bathroom.sentence: I wash my hands in the bathroom.

living room.sentence: We watch TV in the living room.

tests_en: Where do we sleep?

extras_en.matn_en: I say, you find the room! We sleep — bedroom. We cook — kitchen. We wash — bathroom. We sit on the sofa — living room.

Xonadagi narsalar.intro_en: Hello! Look at my room. I see a chair, a lamp and a clock. What do you see?

lamp.sentence: The lamp is on the table.

clock.sentence: The clock is big and white.

extras_en.matn_en: Look around your room! Is there a chair? Show me! A lamp? A TV? A clock? Clap for every thing you find!

Mushuk qayerda?.intro_en: Oh no! Where is the cat? Let's look for it together. Is it in the box?

Where is the cat?.sentence: Where is the cat? I don't know!

in the box.sentence: The cat is in the box.

on the table.sentence: The ball is on the table.

under the bed.sentence: My shoes are under the bed.

tests_en: The kitten is in the box. How do we say it?

extras_en.matn_en: Hide Teddy! Grown-up: Where is Teddy? Child: In the box! On the chair! Under the bed!

Bugun havo qanday?.intro_en: Good morning, friends! Let's look out of the window. What's the weather like today?

It's sunny..sentence: It's sunny. Let's go to the park!

It's windy..sentence: It's windy. Let's fly a kite!

tests_en: The sun is shining in the sky. What's the weather like?

extras_en.matn_en: Let's sing: What's the weather like today? It's sunny, it's sunny, hooray! Now sing it with rainy and windy!

Issiq va sovuq.intro_en: Hi! Some days are hot and some days are cold. Let's talk about the weather!

It's snowy..sentence: It's snowy. Let's make a snowman!

It's cloudy..sentence: It's cloudy. I can't see the sun.

It's hot..sentence: It's hot. I want ice cream!

It's cold..sentence: It's cold. Put on your coat!

tests_en: It is snowing outside. What do we say?

extras_en.matn_en: Listen and move! It's hot — fan your face! It's cold — shake! It's snowy — make a snowball! It's cloudy — float like a cloud!

To'rt fasl.intro_en: Hello, friends! A year has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Which one do you like?

summer.sentence: In summer, it's hot and sunny.

tests_en: The leaves are yellow and falling. What season is it?
Snow and a snowman. What season is it?

extras_en.matn_en: The seasons go round: spring, summer, autumn, winter — and spring again! Spring — flowers. Summer — sea. Autumn — leaves. Winter — snow.

Soyabon va kamalak.intro_en: Hi! It's rainy today, so I have an umbrella. Look! After the rain, I see a rainbow!

rainbow.action_en: Draw a rainbow in the air!

tests_en: It's rainy. What do we take with us?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: What's the weather like? Child: It's rainy. Kabutar: Take your umbrella! Child: Look! A rainbow!

Menga yoqadi.intro_en: Hello, friends! I like apples. I like my friends too! What do you like?

I like apples..sentence: I like apples. They are red!

I like cats..sentence: I like cats. They are small.

tests_en: What does "I like cats" mean?

extras_en.matn_en: I say a thing. If you like it, make a heart with your hands and say: I like it! Bananas? Dogs? Cake? Milk?

Menga yoqmaydi.intro_en: Hi! We like many things. But some things we don't like. I don't like rain!

I don't like onions..sentence: No, thank you. I don't like onions.

I don't like rain..sentence: I don't like rain. It's cold.

I don't like spiders..sentence: I don't like spiders. They are scary!

tests_en: A boy sees an onion and makes a face. What does he say?

extras_en.matn_en: I say a thing, you show your thumb! Thumb up: I like it. Thumb down: I don't like it. Cake? Onions? Rain? Sweets?

Senga yoqadimi?.intro_en: Hello, friends! Let's ask our friends. Do you like cake? Yes, I do!

Yes, I do..sentence: Do you like cake? Yes, I do.

No, I don't..sentence: Do you like spiders? No, I don't.

tests_en: "Do you like ice cream?" You like it. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Kabutar: Do you like milk? Child: Yes, I do. Kabutar: Do you like spiders? Child: No, I don't! Now you ask Kabutar!

Eng sevimli narsam.intro_en: Hi, friends! My favourite colour is blue, like the sky. What is your favourite toy?

My favourite toy is a ball..sentence: My favourite toy is a ball.

I love my mum..sentence: I love my mum very much.

extras_en.matn_en: Bring your favourite toy! Show it and say: My favourite toy is… Then say: My favourite colour is…

Menda bor.intro_en: Hello, friends! I have a nest and a little friend. What do you have? Let's tell!

I have a cat..sentence: I have a cat. It is white.

I have a dog..sentence: I have a dog. It is big.

I have a doll..sentence: I have a doll with a pink dress.

tests_en: A girl shows her dog. What does she say?

extras_en.matn_en: Put toys in the bag. A grown-up takes one out, you say: I have a ball! I have a doll! What else is in the bag?

Men qila olaman.intro_en: Hi! I can fly! What can you do? Let's jump, run and sing together!
tests_en: "I can swim." Which picture is it?

extras_en.matn_en: I say, you do it and say it! I can jump! — jump! I can run! — run! I can swim! — swim! I can sing! — sing!

Qila olaman, qila olmayman.intro_en: Hello, friends! I can fly, but I can't swim. You can dance and draw! Let's see.

I can dance..sentence: I can dance with my friends.

I can draw..sentence: I can draw a big house.
I can draw..action_en: Draw a circle in the air!

I can't fly..sentence: I'm a boy. I can't fly.

tests_en: A boy flaps his arms, but he can't fly. What does he say?

extras_en.matn_en: Sing and move: I can clap, clap, clap! I can dance, dance, dance! I can jump, jump, jump! At the end, flap your arms: I can't fly!

Men endi kattaman!.intro_en: Hello, my big friends! You are five, and you know many English words. I am so happy!

I am five..sentence: My name is Ali. I am five.

I am big..sentence: I am big. I can run fast.

I am happy!.sentence: I am happy! I like English!

tests_en: How old are you? You are five. What do you say?

extras_en.matn_en: Take the microphone and go on stage! Say: Hello! My name is… I am five. I have a cat. I can dance. I like apples. See you soon!

scenarios.name: Bog'chada yangi do'st
scenarios.goal: Bola bog'chada yangi do'st bilan salomlashadi, ismini so'raydi va o'yinchoqlarni sanaydi
scenarios.intro: Bog'chaga yangi bola keldi. Keling, u bilan tanishamiz va birga sanaymiz!
scenarios.intro_en: A new friend comes to kindergarten. Let's say hello and count toys together!

scene.image_prompt: Two smiling children meeting in a bright kindergarten playroom with toy blocks on the floor, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: My name is Anvar. Let's play!

questions.q: Yangi do'stning ismini bilmoqchisiz. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: You want to know your new friend's name. What do you say?
Your friend is going home. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Buvimnikiga mehmonga
scenarios.goal: Bola buvisi bilan salomlashadi, hol-ahvol so'raydi va oilasini tanishtiradi
scenarios.intro: Biz buvimnikiga mehmonga keldik. Buvimiz bilan salomlashamiz va hol so'raymiz.
scenarios.intro_en: We are visiting grandma today. Let's say hello and ask how she is!

dialog.say: Grandma, this is my friend Ali.
Thank you, grandma! I am happy!

questions.q: Buvingiz [en]How are you?[/en] deb so'radi. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: Grandma asks, "How are you?" What do you say?
Show your friend to grandma. What do you say?
questions.why_en: Yes! This is my friend Ali.

scenarios.name: Sayrga kiyinamiz
scenarios.goal: Bola havoga qarab kiyinadi va kiyimlarini inglizcha aytadi
scenarios.intro: Onamiz bilan sayrga chiqamiz. Tashqarida sovuq, issiq kiyinamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We are going for a walk with mum. It's cold, so let's put on warm clothes!

scene.image_prompt: A mother helping a child put on a coat, hat and scarf in a cozy hallway by the door, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: OK! I put on my coat.
Yes. It's cold. Put on your hat!
Put on your gloves and boots too.

questions.q_en: It's cold. What do you put on your head?
What do you put on your hands?

questions.q: Onangiz [en]Put on your hat![/en] dedi. U nima demoqchi?
questions.q_en: Mum says, "Put on your hat!" What do you do?
questions.why_en: Yes! I put on my hat.

scenarios.name: Uyda nonushta
scenarios.goal: Bola nonushtada ovqat va ichimlik so'raydi, rahmat aytadi
scenarios.intro: Ertalab oila bilan nonushta qilamiz. Nima yeymiz, nima ichamiz?
scenarios.intro_en: Good morning! It's breakfast time with the family. What do you want?

scene.image_prompt: A family breakfast table with bread, eggs, cheese, tea and milk, a mother and a child smiling in a bright kitchen, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Here you are. Bread and an egg.

questions.q_en: You want some milk. What do you say?
Breakfast is very good. What do you say?

scenarios.name: Mushukchani qidiramiz
scenarios.goal: Bola uyda mushukchani qidiradi va xona hamda joy nomlarini aytadi
scenarios.intro: Uyimizdagi mushukcha yo'qolib qoldi! Dadamiz bilan xonalarda qidiramiz.
scenarios.intro_en: Oh no! Where is our kitten? Let's look for it in every room with dad!

scene.image_prompt: A father and a child looking for a kitten in a cozy bedroom, the kitten peeking from under the bed, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: No. It's not in the kitchen.

questions.q_en: You can't find the cat. What do you ask?

scenarios.name: Bog'ga chiqamizmi?
scenarios.name_en: Can we go to the park?
scenarios.goal: Bola ob-havoni so'raydi va unga qarab kiyinadi yoki soyabon oladi
scenarios.intro: Biz bog'ga sayrga chiqmoqchimiz. Avval havo qandayligini bilib olamiz!
scenarios.intro_en: We want to go to the park. What's the weather like today?

scene.image_prompt: A child and a mother looking out of a window at light rain and a rainbow over a green park, holding an umbrella, cute cartoon scene for kids, soft flat colors, no text, square

dialog.say: Mum, can we go to the park?
Yes! Let's go to the park!

questions.q_en: It's raining. What's the weather like?
What do we take in the rain?

questions.q: Osmonda yetti rangli yoy paydo bo'ldi. Bu nima?
questions.q_en: You see many colours in the sky. What is it?

scenarios.name: Bozorda meva tanlaymiz
scenarios.goal: Bola bozorda nima yoqishi va yoqmasligini aytadi, odob bilan meva so'raydi
scenarios.intro: Buvimiz bilan bozorga keldik. Qaysi mevani yaxshi ko'ramiz?
scenarios.intro_en: We are at the market with grandma. What fruit do you like?

dialog.say: Yes, I do. I like apples.

dialog.say: No, I don't. I don't like onions.

questions.q: Buvingiz [en]Do you like apples?[/en] deb so'radi. Sizga yoqadi. Nima deysiz?
questions.q_en: Grandma asks, "Do you like apples?" You like them. What do you say?
You don't like onions. What do you say?

scenarios.goal: Bola tug'ilgan kunida yoshini aytadi, nima qila olishini ko'rsatadi va mehmonlar bilan xayrlashadi
scenarios.intro: Bugun do'stimizning tug'ilgan kuni! Tabriklaymiz, o'ynaymiz va raqs tushamiz.

dialog.say: Happy birthday! How old are you?
I have a ball for you.
Thank you! I can dance. Let's dance!
dialog.uz: rahmat! men raqs tusha olaman. keling, raqs tushamiz!
men qo'shiq aytib, qarsak chala olaman!

questions.q: Do'stingiz besh yoshda. U nima deydi?
questions.q_en: Your friend is five. What does he say?
Your present is a ball. What do you say?
options: ⚽ I have a ball for you.
questions.why: To'g'ri! [en]I have a ball for you.[/en]
questions.why_en: Yes! I have a ball for you.

questions.q_en: The party is over. What do you say?
